model_annotation: Figure 2 displays a bar chart illustrating the average negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant model tokens, comparing the baseline MISTRAL-v0.2 model against its fine-tuned variants on six distinct clinical specialty datasets. The horizontal axis categorizes the specialties: Cardio, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, with the sixth specialty, Gastro, positioned between Cardio and Infect. The vertical axis represents the negative log-probability values, scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. Each specialty is represented by a single bar, colored according to its category: Cardio (blue), Infect (orange), Neuro (green), Obstetrics (purple), Pediatrics (red), and Gastro (yellow). The bar heights correspond to the average negative log-probabilities, with the shortest bar for Gastro at approximately 3.7 and the tallest bar for Pediatrics at approximately 4.3. The bars are sorted in descending order of height, indicating the order of average negative log-probabilities from lowest to highest. The chart visually emphasizes the comparison between the baseline model and its fine-tuned variants across specialties, with each color representing a different specialty dataset.
